description: This file defines an internal interface IAsyncTimer within the Orleans.Runtime namespace, which extends IDisposable and IHealthCheckable, and declares a method for scheduling the next timer tick with an optional delay.
external_methods: IHealthCheckable (assumed to be in the same namespace or referenced assembly)

methods.name: NextTick
methods.description: Asynchronously schedules the next timer tick, optionally overriding the delay, returning true if the timer tick was successfully scheduled.
